name: MiniMenu
description: Small utility mod: noclip, hitboxes, trajectory, replay bot.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Ignore death. Also puts the level in test mode so nothing is submitted.

trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
trajectory.description: Draws predicted paths for holding and not holding.

trajectory-debug.name: Trajectory Debug Text
trajectory-debug.description: Shows steps simulated, distance moved, and whether the sim died.

trajectory-time-scale.name: Trajectory Time Scale
trajectory-time-scale.description: Multiplier on the simulation step. If the path is a tiny dot, try 60.

bot-mode.name: Replay Bot
bot-mode.description: Record inputs, or replay them. Replay mode puts the level in test mode.
